homeSection3.title: A space for different types of content
homeSection3.description: Korevax was designed to organize different forms of digital content into a single, connected structure.

description.desc: Korevax is an open-source project designed to connect people, data and applications around digital content.
description.desc1: An open project, developed collaboratively and accessible to the community.
description.desc2: Information organized to facilitate discovery, consultation, and connections between content.
description.desc3: People can contribute, evaluate information, and help the ecosystem evolve.

homeSection2.title: What is Korevax?
homeSection2.description1: Korevax is an open-source ecosystem designed to facilitate the discovery, organization, and exploration of digital content. Focused on the preservation of and access to information, the project aims to bring together various types of content within an open, structured framework, enabling users to find, explore, and establish connections between works, entities, and information in a simple and organized manner.
homeSection2.description2: This structure allows for the connection of works, entities, and information, creating a foundation that can be explored by individuals, collaborators, and various applications.

homeSection5.title: What makes Korevax different?
homeSection5.description: Korevax is designed as an open, connected foundation — not just a list of titles.
